name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-02-02, at wavelengths from 1.08 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
